verdicts.decision_note: The client introduces the task-local cover-design requirement that title typography be consistent across the front, spine, and back; administrative deadline and budget details are not included in the Event payload.
The client specifies the bold gold-gradient front title as the visual reference and requires the spine and back titles to match it; the added attributes do not conflict with or obsolete prior state.
Target-specific implementation claim: the freelancer reports that the spine and back title fonts now match the front title font.
First concrete client verification: the client visually confirms that the title-font correction looks good and was completed properly.
